reason: Compared the full printed source lem:weak-open and its proof, together with def:weak, against the compiled theorem SM.weak_open and all geometric, topological, polygonal and coordinate definitions used by it. The sole explicit hypothesis is the inherited n>=3 restriction. The first conjunction proves openness of the actual weakLocus in the ambient real-coordinate tuple space. WeakGeneric is the previously reviewed weak condition, not G1: it permits disjoint parallel and collinear remote pairs and imposes transversality only at actual remote intersections. WeakGeometry derives the needed adjacent-intersection and remote-interior properties from nonzero turns, nonzero edges and vertex/closed-segment exclusion alone. The G2 characterization by absence of remote closed triples is re-proved from these weak hypotheses rather than importing its G1-specific version. WeakTopology preserves vertex exclusions using actual disjointness from a degenerate point-segment. For each remote pair it separates central disjointness, handled by genuine closed-segment disjointness persistence without a nonzero determinant assumption, from central intersection, where weak transversality supplies a determinant whose nonzeroness persists. Nearby uniqueness then follows from the concrete affine parameter equations. The compact closed-triple argument preserves G2. This is a valid alternative proof of the source openness statement and does not assume any requested property as an axiom or additional input. The second conjunction covers every actual labelled visible component. labelledVisibleChamber_image proves that the image of its subtype connectedComponent is exactly connectedComponentIn weakLocus at the tuple, so the asserted openness is in the ambient tuple space rather than merely relative openness inside an arbitrary component. PolygonallyConnected means that every two points in this set are related by PolygonalJoin. PolygonalJoin is Relation.ReflTransGen of the relation that the entire closed real affine segment between consecutive endpoints lies in that same set. This inductive closure has finitely many straight-segment steps; it is neither an arbitrary continuous path renamed polygonal nor a chain allowed to leave the component. Its reflexive case is harmless because the outer definition requires both endpoints inside the set. The local-convex-neighborhood reachability proof shows that the reachable subset and its complement are open, then uses actual connectedness to obtain all points of the component. The third conjunction gives each weakly generic labelled tuple a radius r>0 whose centred euclideanTupleBall is contained in its own component. tupleCoordinates enumerates both real coordinates of every vertex using Fin n times Fin 2, and coordinatesTuple is an explicitly proved two-sided continuous inverse on the source n>=3 domain. The pinned mathlib EuclideanSpace is the PiLp space with exponent 2. Therefore the ball is the actual Euclidean ball on all 2n coordinates, not the ambient default product max-metric ball or an unspecified neighborhood. Its centre and positive radius prevent vacuous ball inclusion, and the homeomorphism connects its topology to the actual tuple product topology. All three printed conclusions are present, with no G1, separation-distance, intersection-persistence, component-openness or connectivity hypothesis added. The current development receipt passed its build/axiom audit over 330 declarations, with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; it is explicitly a development receipt, not completion of the focused stage. Every supporting current file hash was checked against that receipt. This independent source review is additional supporting-source evidence: lem:weak-open is absent from the frozen focused NODES.tsv and must not increase the original 132-proof or 191-checklist baseline counts. Its supporting helper lemmas are not counted as original claims.

countersignature_20260913.reason: The printed lemma (reference/SM/sm-1-polygons.tex:290-296) asserts, on labelled representatives with the inherited n>=3 domain, that (1) W_n is open in (R^2)^n, (2) every connected component of W_n is open and polygonally connected, and (3) every labelled weakly generic tuple has an open ball contained in its visible chamber. SM.weak_open (work/lean/SM/WeakOpen.lean:31-37) takes exactly hn : 3 <= n and concludes (1) IsOpen (weakLocus n), (2) for every P : WeakTuple n the image in LabelledTuple n of labelledVisibleChamber P is open and PolygonallyConnected, and (3) for every P : WeakTuple n there is r > 0 with euclideanTupleBall P.val r contained in that image. Quantifying components by a member P covers every component. The definitions denote the printed objects: LabelledTuple n = ZMod n -> R x R with Mathlib's standard product topology (no custom topology instances in work/lean/SM); WeakGeneric (WeakGeneric.lean:11-19) is def:weak clause by clause (edge P i != 0; turn P i != 0 with turn = chi(i-1,i,i+1); P k not in edgeSegment P i for non-incident k; for remote i,j any common point forces det(edge i, edge j) != 0 and common points are unique; G2 as absence of a point in three edge interiors with pairwise distinct indices), matching sm-1-polygons.tex:279-289 and def:polygon/def:chirotope/def:generic (lines 27-52, 63-70, 100-108); labelledVisibleChamber P = connectedComponent P in the subtype (the visible chamber of def:weak); PolygonallyConnected (PolygonalConnected.lean:17-21) is ReflTransGen of "the closed segment lies in S", i.e. a finite polygonal chain inside the set; euclideanTupleBall (EuclideanTuple.lean:14-17, 66-67) is the Euclidean ball on all 2n real coordinates. No genericity, distance or connectivity hypothesis is added, nothing is vacuous, and sm15_reworded is false (the SM15 excerpt is identical to SM12; CHANGES_SINCE_20260909.md section 1 does not list this lemma). The Lean statement matches the SM15 text.
stronger_than_source: Clause (3): the Lean ball is centred at the tuple itself (euclideanTupleBall P.val r) whereas the source only says the tuple 'has an open ball contained in its visible chamber'; a centred ball is the natural reading and at least as strong.
Clause (2): openness of each component is asserted in the ambient space LabelledTuple n (IsOpen of the image), which is the strongest reading; it coincides with relative openness since W_n is open.
